name: Castellated / edge-plated hole geometry
description: Validate plated holes that cross the board outline (castellations): each should be cleanly bisected by the edge, not left as a thin plated sliver, and castellations should not be packed tighter than the plating process allows.
what_it_measures: For every plated hole intersected by the board outline, how much of the plated barrel remains inside the copper (a sliver leaves an incomplete/​breaking-out barrel) and the centre-to-centre pitch between adjacent castellations.
